kb.text: Home loan interest rates start at 8.5% per annum for salaried applicants with a strong credit profile. The rate is floating and linked to the repo rate.
A one-time processing fee of Rs. 25,000 plus GST is charged when the loan is sanctioned.
The maximum home loan tenure is 30 years. The minimum tenure is 5 years.
Home loan amounts start at 10 lakh and go up to 5 crore, subject to eligibility.
Documents required: PAN card, Aadhaar card, last 3 months salary slips, last 6 months bank statements and the property papers.
To be eligible, a salaried applicant needs a minimum monthly income of Rs. 30,000 and at least 2 years of work experience.
There are no prepayment charges on floating rate home loans. You can part-pay or foreclose at any time without a penalty.
Applicants must be between 21 and 65 years of age at the end of the loan tenure.
Loan approval typically takes 7 working days after all documents are submitted.
A minimum CIBIL score of 700 is preferred for the best interest rate. Applicants with lower scores may still be considered at a higher rate.
You can transfer an existing home loan from another bank to Nexa Finserv. Balance transfer helps you get a lower interest rate.
Our advisors are available Monday to Saturday, from 9:30 AM to 7:00 PM. Call 1800123456 or visit any branch.
